newsitem.title: JAPAN: TOCOM aluminium scores solid gains on LME, dollar.
newsitem.headline: TOCOM aluminium scores solid gains on LME, dollar.

text.p: Tokyo yen-based aluminium scored solid gains on Tuesday as the metal's healthy performance in London overnight and the dollar's recovery against the yen sparked short-covering by trading houses, traders said.

"We've seen short-covering, mainly by trade houses," said a trader. "There's a feeling aluminium on the LME might rebound after consolidating the floor around $1,550. We might see some bargain-hunters here."
The June contract, which came into life last week, added 3.0 yen to end at 191.1 yen per kg while the April gained 2.9 yen to 192.4 yen. Others ranged from 2.1 to 2.9 yen higher.
In London overnight, the benchmark three-month aluminium ended up $23 at $1,598, just under the key $1,600, building up on supportive buying seen on recent dips.
